parsed.name: OBIS 激光器
parsed.description: OBIS 激光器是一种实验室激光光源，常用于显微成像和其他光学实验中的受控照明与激发。它可作为显微镜光源使用，提供稳定激光输出，并支持开关状态与触发方式控制。
parsed.description_en: An OBIS laser is a laboratory laser light source commonly used for controlled illumination and excitation in microscopy and other optical experiments. It serves as a microscope light source, providing stable laser output with controllable on/off state and trigger behavior.
